name: TC SQL Query Bridge
description: Unified SQL query protocol layer. Route + auth + execute. Any data owner joins by declaration.
description_zh: 统一SQL查询协议层。路由+鉴权+执行，任何数据拥有方通过声明加入。

directives.usage_zh: SQL查询;查询,<数据库代称>,<JSON查询描述>
directives.description: Query rows from a database table. JSON: {table, columns, where?, limit?}
directives.description_zh: 从数据库表中查询行。JSON参数：{table表名, columns列名, where?等值条件, limit?行数上限}

params_desc.db_alias: Database alias as defined in sql_permissions.json
params_desc.query_json: JSON query descriptor: {table, columns, where?, limit?}

directives.usage_zh: SQL查询;表列表,<数据库代称>
directives.description: List all tables in a database.

params_desc.db_alias: Database alias as defined in sql_permissions.json

directives.usage_zh: SQL查询;表结构,<数据库代称>,<JSON>
directives.description: Get table column info (PRAGMA table_info). JSON: {table}
directives.description_zh: 获取表的列结构信息（PRAGMA table_info）。JSON参数：{table表名}

params_desc.db_alias: Database alias as defined in sql_permissions.json

directives.description: Count rows in a table. JSON: {table, where?}
directives.description_zh: 统计表中行数。JSON参数：{table表名, where?等值条件}

params_desc.db_alias: Database alias as defined in sql_permissions.json
